description: Create an inventory item. Requires the manager role. A category is required unless isDraft is true: a call without categoryId returns { missingCategory, categories } and writes nothing. The server checks that the category exists, not that it fits the item. Required fields per category come from get_item_requirements; when some are missing the call returns { missingFields } and creates nothing, and the same call with those values in customFields (keys = fieldDefId) creates the item. isDraft: true saves an incomplete draft without the required-field and category checks, which the user finishes in the app. At the organization's item allowance the call returns { itemLimitReached } and creates nothing; drafts do not count against the allowance and can still be saved at it. For quantity-tracked stock (consumables like paper or markers) pass trackingMode "quantity" with quantity and an optional minStock. With clientRequestId a repeated call returns the existing item instead of a duplicate; without it every call creates a new item. preview_item_create renders the same proposal as an editable confirm card in widget hosts; its button calls this tool.

categoryId.description: Category id (from get_item_requirements); required unless isDraft is true

clientRequestId.description: A unique id for this creation (e.g. a UUID). A repeated call with the SAME id returns the existing item instead of creating a duplicate; a new id creates a new item.

customFields.description: Field values keyed by fieldDefId (from get_item_requirements). Dates as a plain calendar day "YYYY-MM-DD" (a full timestamp works too, but only WITH an explicit offset — this server has no timezone and does no conversion), selects as one of the listed options, multiselect as an ARRAY of option strings, currency as a plain number in the field's own currency (see its currencyCode; default CHF), url as a full http(s) link (protocol added when missing).

homeLocationId.description: Home location resource id (from search_resources); absent = the category or organization default

isDraft.description: Save as an incomplete draft (skips the required-fields check; the user finishes it in the app)

minStock.description: Optional restock threshold for quantity-tracked stock

quantity.description: Initial stock amount — required with trackingMode "quantity"

trackingMode.description: "quantity" for quantity-tracked stock (consumables) instead of a serialized single item

name: create_item

allowance.description: Items the organization's package includes, with itemLimitReached

categories.description: The organization's category tree, sent with a missingCategory round so the retry costs one call. Empty means the org has no categories yet

compartment.description: The compartment of that container the item sits in (absent = directly in the container)

container.description: The container this item is packed into, if any

effectiveHolder.description: Holder followed through the container chain

effectiveLocation.description: Location followed through the container chain

instruction.description: Explanation of a round that wrote nothing (missing fields, missing category, allowance reached)

isDraft.description: Present and true only for an unfinished draft capture

itemLimitReached.description: Present and true when the organization is at its included item allowance — nothing was created and no retry of this call will succeed

missingCategory.description: Present and true when the call carried no categoryId — nothing was created; every item except a draft needs a category

missingFieldLabels.description: Labels a saved DRAFT still needs before it can be published — the user finishes them in the app

missingFields.description: Present INSTEAD of the item when required values are missing: nothing was created; the same call with these values in customFields creates it

currencyCode.description: ISO code of a currency field when it is not CHF (absent = CHF)

label.description: Field label as the org named it

type.description: Field type: text | number | date | select | multiselect | …

modelId.description: The item's model — pass it as create_order lines[].modelId to order any instance of this model

primaryCode.description: The code printed on the item's asset tag — how a human tells two identical models apart. Absent when no code is attached

quantity.description: How many this row stands for — only on quantity-tracked pools. To count a pool, SUM this; to count serialized items, count rows

status.description: Condition: available | in_repair | defect | lost | retired ("available" means not defect/lost/retired — the item may still be borrowed)

trackingMode.description: "quantity" for a stock pool counted by amount. Absent = a serialized item, i.e. this row IS one physical thing

usage.description: Tracked items the organization has, with itemLimitReached

webUrl.description: Link to this item in the web app, for a person to open. Absent when the deployment has no public address configured

title: Create item
